=== Level 92–99: Redwood shields ===
{{plinkp|Redwood shield}} [[Redwood shield]]s are an alternative method to fletching bows. Fletching one shield requires two redwood logs, and gives 216 experience per shield. With a [[Fletching knife]], the XP rates increase substantially.
